traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 010.1-DEV-CONFIGURABLE-PATTERNS are implemented and verified. The valid-annotation-format rule exposes nested and flat configuration options for story and requirement patterns and examples, validates regex patterns and reports configuration errors while falling back to safe defaults, and keeps behavior backward compatible when options are missing or invalid. Error messages incorporate optional example strings with clear precedence between nested and flat settings. A JSON schema describes these options and is wired into the rule’s meta.schema, matching ESLint best practices. User-facing documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md explains the configuration fields, usage, and behavior. Tests explicitly linked to this story cover configuration, examples, precedence, and error handling, and all pass in the current test run, so the story is considered fully satisfied.
